verdict.rationale: Filee documents per-file-type image presets covering quality and resizing, handles iPhone HEIC input, and has built-in raster-to-SVG tracing. Quality and size control are clearly delivered, but the format coverage and compression parts of the story are not fully shown. Missing for 10: explicit WebP and JPEG format support, a documented image-specific compression control (compression is only documented for PDFs), detail on quality/size parameter ranges, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, common image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) convert with control over quality, size, and compression
